major_width_status: two-lane secondary roads from OSM; 3 m per lane is an explicit engineering choice, not a field measurement
steep_transition_status: engineering limits on derived grading, not surveyed shoulder widths; preserve steep source banks outside the native road-support cells
route_axis_policy: preserve original source file; bounded derived alignment at three independently observed banks, with sampled LiDAR bench and explicit engineering status
bridge_policy: separate deck and observed lateral barriers; preserve measured low ground, mask only source surface too close to deck
crossfall_policy: zero design crossfall; not an assertion of surveyed camber
